verdict.rationale: Bento documents an API reference browser for scanning endpoints, request fields and response fields alongside hand-written docs (bento-docs-32), supported by API conventions and error docs (bento-docs-20, bento-docs-31). Nothing shows the reference can execute requests or offers runnable examples, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed standard paths (bento-probe-3). missing for 10: runnable/try-it request execution, executable code examples in the reference, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
